title: NEB Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the End Repair, Adapter Ligation and Bead Clean Up for the [NEB Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep](https://www.neb.com/products/e7805-nebnext-ultra-ii-fs-dna-library-prep-kit-for-illumina#Protocols,%20Manuals%20&%20Usage) --- * [P20-multi channel GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [P300-multi channel GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons Thermocycler Module](https://opentrons.com/modules/thermocycler-module/) * [Opentrons Temperature Module](https://opentrons.com/modules/temperature-module/) * [Opentrons Magnetic Module](https://opentrons.com/modules/temperature-module/) * [NEST 100uL PCR Plate](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/lab-plates/products/nest-0-1-ml-96-well-pcr-plate-full-skirt) * [Opentrons 96 Well Aluminum Block with 200 uL PCR Strips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/racks-and-adapters/products/aluminum-block-set) --- * Thermocycler (Slot 7) * Temperature Module (Slot 4) * Magnetic Module (Slot 9) * Opentrons 200 uL Filter Tips (Slot 3) * Opentrons 20 uL Filter Tips (Slots 1, 2, 5) Initial Starting State: - Samples start in a 96 well PCR plate in the thermocycler. - Temperature Block starts at 4C. - End Prep Mastermix, Adapter Mastermix, and PCR Mix should be in columns 1-3, respectively, in the 96 Well Aluminum block on the temperature module. - Reservoir channel A1 contains ethanol - Plate on the magnetic module contains pre-aliquoted magnetic beads and EB
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Configure deck and load reagents
steps.instruction: Place the following hardware on the Opentrons deck: P20‑multi‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, P300‑multi‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, Opentrons Thermocycler Module (Slot 7), Opentrons Temperature Module (Slot 4), Opentrons Magnetic Module (Slot 9), NEST 100 µL PCR Plate, and an Opentrons 96‑well aluminum block with 200 µL PCR strips. Load filter tip racks: 200 µL tips in Slot 3 and 20 µL tips in Slots 1, 2, and 5.

steps.title: Prepare initial labware state
steps.instruction: Put the samples in a 96‑well PCR plate and place the plate in the thermocycler. Set the temperature module (the block) to 4 °C. Load End Prep Mastermix, Adapter Mastermix, and PCR Mix into columns 1, 2, and 3 respectively of the 96‑well aluminum block on the temperature module. Fill reservoir channel A1 with ethanol. Load the magnetic module plate with pre‑aliquoted magnetic beads and EB solution.

steps.title: Enter protocol inputs
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons software, input the number of samples, specify the mount (left/right) for each pipette, and indicate whether to run each part of the library‑prep protocol.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file for the NEB Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons App (OT App).

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as described in the deck map, matching each piece of hardware to its designated slot.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and pipettes. Refer to Opentrons support articles for calibration tip procedures if needed.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the automated End Repair, Adapter Ligation, and bead clean‑up steps.
